prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs replace the naive parsing in extract_field_from_www_auth (src/mcp/client/auth/utils.py) that split/matched WWW-Authenticate auth-params without respecting quoted-string commas, causing substring/partial-token matches. Each adds a quote-aware, escape-aware tokenizer to split the header into individual auth-param segments before matching a field by exact key. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: 3041 adds an explicit scheme-aware step (_extract_bearer_auth_params) that isolates the Bearer challenge's params via segment.partition(' ') before matching fields, so it correctly handles a WWW-Authenticate header containing multiple challenges (e.g. 'Basic realm=..., Bearer error=...'). 3012's _iter_www_auth_params only strips the header's first space-delimited token and treats everything after as one flat comma-separated param list, so a second scheme name appearing later in a multi-challenge header would be parsed in as part of a param token rather than recognized as a new challenge boundary.

clusters.pick_reason: 3041 adds an explicit scheme-aware step (_extract_bearer_auth_params) that isolates the Bearer challenge's params via segment.partition(' ') before matching fields, so it correctly handles a WWW-Authenticate header containing multiple challenges (e.g. 'Basic realm=..., Bearer error=...'). 3012's _iter_www_auth_params only strips the header's first space-delimited token and treats everything after as one flat comma-separated param list, so a second scheme name appearing later in a multi-challenge header would be parsed in as part of a param token rather than recognized as a new challenge boundary.
